data_a.situation: A shortfall on the Ashvale Bridal House delivery for Thursday needs the workroom manager's authorisation on job QM-2031-0541.
known_facts: Four of the sixteen pieces on QM-2031-0541 cannot be finished for Thursday 9 October because the 22 mm grosgrain has not arrived.
The workroom escalation procedure sets out three permitted recovery routes for a shortfall and requires the message to request one of them by name.
The workroom manager can authorise a named permitted route; she cannot sign off a shortfall that names none, and 'whichever works' is not something she can authorise.
The coordinator settled on one of the three permitted routes yesterday afternoon after going through the alternates list and the delivery dates.
Ashvale need the named route in writing before 11:00 on Wednesday 8 October; after that their own production schedule stands as it is.
Every other figure on the shortfall is settled: four pieces of sixteen, one cause, one delivery date.
constraints: Shortfall recovery is authorised by the workroom manager.
The coordinator does not write to Ashvale about a shortfall until a route is authorised.

turns.input_raw:
Check this before I send it to Marit, please.

Draft under review:
Marit - we will be four short of the sixteen for Ashvale on Thursday; the 22 mm grosgrain has not landed. Can you authorise the recovery route I settled on yesterday, so I can put it to Ashvale before 11:00 this morning? They need the route named in writing, and the procedure will not let you sign off a shortfall without a named route.
